item.title: Health, Environment, and Politics Clash Over New U.S. AI Data Centers
item.description:
Health, Environment, and Politics Clash Over New U.S. AI Data Centers

New, large‑scale AI data centers are being built across U.S. neighborhoods, sparking a heated debate about health, environment, and politics.

📊 Overview

  • “Many U.S. residents say their health problems are being caused by new data centers being built in their neighborhoods.”
  • “President Trump only sees the potential economic benefits of these large‑scale projects.”
  • “Not all elected officials agree with him, including Democratic House Representative Alexandria Ocasio‑Cortez, who is sounding the alarm on the environmental impact — and she’s not the only one.”
  • “This debate is having a significant effect on the upcoming U.S. midterm elections, deepening the divide between supporters and opponents.”
  • “There is no doubt that the AI boom will change the U.S., but at what cost?”
  • “A report by Ines Pohl.”
